notes.title: What a month that was! 😮
notes.notes: [p]What a month! We’re safely back home from Gamescom and have finally beat the Gamescom bug (🤧), so it’s about time we slide in here to say another big [b]THANK YOU[/b] for the support and help with Ritual of Raven these past few weeks, and also to give you a little update on where this game and our studio is heading next! ✨[/p][h2]🎊 August was really something![/h2][p][i]August 7th.[/i] The day that will go down in the history of cozy games. And Ritual of Raven was part of it! 🔮[/p][p]For our release Malin (Social Media & Community Management) even flew all the way from Germany to Scotland to join Kathrin & Kasimir (Programming) for a little release party! And then once it was time for the game to actually go live, Sophie (Game Art) and Zoë (Game Design) joined via Discord call and our amazing soundtrack artist Marie also stopped by. 🥂 (More on the soundtrack later! 🤫)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/c9f93a299af83629dbaae0aa4bf02f3a8d0f7335.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We also went to Glasgow Indie Games Fest around the same time and only two weeks later you could find us walking around Gamescom. Lots of amazing conversations with people who are as enthusiastic about games as we are, we’re definitely looking forward to the next convention! 🥰[/p][p](This was actually the first time the 5 of us got together “IRL”!)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/007a18663f5088e9d99766243edf105b886fc772.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]🫂 Community[/h2][p]Now THIS is why we make games at the end of the day. You! 💜[/p][p]Working on a project for such a long time and only sharing small snippets here and there can sometimes make you feel almost isolated and make you really lose sight of the bigger picture - but seeing how you guys play this game and decorate the world has never once failed to put a huge smile on our faces! So we can’t not share some of the beautiful snippets with you:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/c50174961be302063eedc64a3b120a7219f30a0b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/94a30385de2d0ae3f9ef51ec461d3ea5ad194b27.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/cb1add2c99b6ca51e01f8190ba175498677850a1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/11886d1be27c4b8116b3029ff6a9bef23d9abae9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Also seeing the amount of hours you guys have already poured into exploring Ritual of Raven and the multiple 100% achievement screenshots we’ve gotten blow us away every time![/p][p][/p][h2]🔮What’s next?[/h2][p]Ok, ok, we hear you! You want to know what’s next for Ritual of Raven or even Spellgarden Games in general. 👀[/p][p]First of all a massive Thank You once again to everyone who has [b]written a review, reported a bug or helped work on the upcoming Wiki[/b]. Yes, you’ve heard that right: A Ritual of Raven Wiki! 😮[/p][h3]🔖Ritual of Raven Wiki?[/h3][p]Some amazing people on our Discord have been putting together all kinds of knowledge on Ritual of Raven and are currently working on an actual Ritual of Raven Wiki - how cool is that? 😍[/p][p]If you’d like to help along (or just generally chat about Ritual of Raven), our Discord server awaits! 🫶[/p][p]Stay tuned, we’ll definitely share the wiki on our socials when it’s here! 🔖[/p][h3]🔄Updates[/h3][p]And what about updates for Ritual of Raven itself? 👀[/p][p]We definitely have loved to hear all your feedback and ideas and have been diligently taking note of them to chat about which changes would be at all feasible to build into the game! We’re equally keeping track of the bugs that are still being reported and going forward [b]will definitely make sure to fix bugs and add some more improvements.[/b][/p][p]But also our fingers are really itching to bring the next vision to life (and to your screens)! 🎮 We started working on a really cool concept that we’re sure you’ll be excited about once we share more![/p][p]So while we won’t just abandon the magical world of Nevar, we are already thinking of the next steps for our small studio. And not to forget we do have another little game that every once in a while demands our attention (🐸). So wherever it is we go next, we hope you’ll be on board for our next shenanigans! 🔮[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/0e188c0b8e40233887326fed3f13aa490dacd3ce.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]🎵 Ritual of Raven Soundtrack[/h2][p]Now before we let you go, we wanted to share one last thing! If you ever need your own witchy soundtrack as you go about your day, Marie (our amazing soundtrack artist) has shared the Ritual of Raven OST on YouTube! Featuring some incredibly adorable art & animation by Sophie by the way, so definitely worth checking out! 🎶[/p][p]And for that extra bit of support for Marie, you can also [url="https://mariehavemann.bandcamp.com/album/ritual-of-raven-original-game-soundtrack"]purchase the soundtrack on Bandcamp[/url]! 💜[/p][previewyoutube="CDc-Y3XTb7w;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Once again thank you so much for going on this magical journey with us and helping us make it better! We’ll see you somewhere soon![/p][p]-Spellgarden Games 🔮[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Quality of Life Patch 1 - Out Now for Ritual of Raven! ✨💟
notes.notes:
Hey everyone 👋✨ [b]Ritual of Raven’s first patch is out now on Steam![/b]

Before we jump into the details of our QoL Patch, we want to [b]thank you for your incredible feedback and reviews since Ritual of Raven's launch! [/b]We're thrilled with the positive reception to our witchy farm-sim game and appreciate all your support 💟

In Quality of Life Patch 1, we've [b]implemented improvements and bug fixes from your feedback[/b] since Ritual of Raven's launch earlier this month! 🥳

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/b8ae733bc6f625ada98767db0d013cb703376c05.png[/img]

This includes fixes to community-reported bugs, such as players losing the ability to interact after moving chests/fields, and a bug that led players to be stuck after certain cutscenes. Alongside this, we've made many improvements, including tweaking the game's tutorial, improving item stacking in the inventory, and more.

[b]Please find the full patch notes for QoL Patch 1 below:[/b]

[h2]Patch Notes - QoL Patch 1 [/h2]
[list][*] Fixed a bug that would lead to loosing the ability to interact with anything after moving chests or fields
[*] Fixed a bug that would lead to players being stuck after certain cutscenes
[*] Fixed a bug where characters could be missing from cutscenes
[*] Fixed the crystal charger to not remove the crystal after closing it with the ESC button
[*] Improved the tutorial to be more flexible with players’ card choices
[*] Added some highlights to indicate where to find certain items in friendship quests
[*] Fixed a bug where items could go missing when harvesting or extracting them with a full construct inventory
[*] Fixed a possible blocked state after loosing extracted items in the second portal keeper quest
[*] Fixed infinite field glitch in puzzles
[*] Improved item stacking in the inventory
[*] Fixed Judgement puzzle to require 4 instead of 1 Poppy Fruit
[*] Fixed Raven disappearing after the end of the main story
[*] Fixed Raven appearing in the wrong position after teleporting
[*] Fixed pointer disappearing after placing a decoration using controller
[*] Fixed a friendship item reappearing after it was already collected
[*] Improved collision in the shortcut of the final area
[*] Improved construct navigation in the second area
[*] Fixed some spelling errors
[*] Some more minor and visual bugfixes[/list][h3]Support Contact[/h3]
If you encounter any issues with Ritual of Raven, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2066520/discussions/1/]please reach out and contact our Support Team here in our Steam Report a Problem forum.[/url]

[b]We hope you enjoy QoL Patch 1 for Ritual of Raven! 🔮[/b]

notes.title: Ritual of Raven (Nintendo Switch) Review
notes.notes:
Naturally, Ritual Of Raven was going to land on my radar as my love of farming sims is well-documented within my work. However, despite how enjoyable and well-crafted a lot of these games are, there are so many that just imitate Story of Seasons or Stardew Valley, with the only innovation being a reduction in restrictions. After a while, it becomes a real “why go out for burgers, when you have steak at home situation.”

Thankfully, Ritual of Raven caught my eye with its adorable aesthetic and unique magic-based gameplay. I was expecting to go in for a fairly reasonable time, growing some crops and maybe learning a little bit of magic along the way. But this game caught me completely off guard with a central mechanic that not only fits the genre but shakes it up in an engaging and interesting way.

notes.title: A trip down MEMORY LANE! 🖼️
notes.notes: [p][i]One month??[/i] Just one more month until the release of Ritual of Raven? That seems surreal! Honestly it feels as though we just announced this game last month and then showed it off at Gamescom for the first time. And now here we are: July 7th, 2025 - exactly one month before the full release (August 7th)! 😮[/p][p]The last few weeks on our end have been spent bug hunting (and catching) 🐛🪲🐞 and with lots of playtesting, so that your experience will hopefully be a rather smooth one! So as we prepare to get our game ready to go, we haven’t really implemented any big changes we want to show you, but rather let’s take this time to look back. To reflect. To see where the idea initially started, how it transformed and how far we’ve come! Hopefully this is as fun for you to see as it was for us! 💜[/p][p][/p][h1]🌱 Early Beginnings[/h1][p]We first started working on the idea of a witchy farming simulator with a twist back in June 2021. And our first goal was to get some funding so we could continue working on it and bring the project to life. And after a few quite nerve-wracking months, we did end up securing said funding - Project Ritual of Raven could continue! 🥳[/p][p]Here’s a few early impressions of some concepts:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/40398982b73b04a79c884d9c3421d6af07854c6d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The first bits of programming we did… 😅[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/ac04932019dea564da213f2bb6feed8be528898c.gif"][/img][/p][p]And some early key art! 🥰[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/5aab15b7aaa367517c72d63bd28861305b83c3a0.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]🤖 Prototype[/h1][p]In January of 2022 we then decided to make it official and founded Spellgarden Games as you know it now! Meanwhile we were constantly working on a prototype for Ritual of Raven that we could then show publishers and colleagues to tweak and improve it. This phase went on until around June 2022, let’s look at a few impressions:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/8cf5e245fe4b2ae757e244606ef2616ecbca9c39.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/3146811296e7e48c92a5041e3dd6ff09ad9af12d.gif"][/img][/p][p]In our next step we started searching for a publisher for this project. This phase actually went on for a while and we even started working on our other game [i]Sticky Business[/i] in the meantime. 😮🐸[/p][p]And then in July of 2023 (two years ago now!) we signed with Team17 and from there on developed Ritual of Raven with monthly milestones. Which basically means we got together at the start to define what would be implemented in the game at the end of each month and then periodically checked in to at some point end up with a finished game in our hands. 🤩[/p][p]During this time we actually made quite a few changes to the overall aesthetic, came up with tons of mock-up UIs and of course always worked on more content and mechanics for the game. Look at this old GIF we found:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/32035e31917271b6926088f06ebb15185f963fd6.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]And then at some point we ended up with the look and feel that you can now see in our game:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/2594e5fe3bf2cbe175594d2d4ca256c2ef5b7da9.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]🎨 Concept vs. Final Art[/h1][p]The main aesthetic aside, let’s also dive into some more specific mechanics and how we came up with the idea for them! 💭[/p][p]Before we truly commit to anything, we usually do little sketches, doodles & tests to try and visualize if a certain idea will work in the game, play well and look nice! And upon diving into our vault full of dev secrets, we found some of these to share with you! 🤫[/p][p][/p][h2]🎣 Portal Fishing[/h2][p]Ritual of Raven of course has its very own fishing mechanic - portal fishing essentially. With this one there’s no complicated mini game but rather we wanted this to feel like one of those arcade claw machines where you can get plushies - but make it magical.[/p][p]First up we started with some basic concepts on the portal and hook style:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/a7be290a4670b5de8553baf33daf9f9dd10f5175.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Then we wanted to visualize this in the game and get a feel for how it plays and if it actually brings that fun twist to it, so we put in some placeholder graphics, had very limited animations and also no sound whatsoever:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/814f5af2b0d45167cd5f86081306155f843d944e.gif"][/img][/p][p]And finally we ended up with this version of our magical arcade-like fishing mechanic:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/71c8269702e9e350a6dec3e17a0690cee54320f2.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]⌛ Seals[/h2][p]In addition to the cards (which act as the direct tasks that will be carried out by the constructs), you can also apply so called seals. These will lead to the magic always being carried out at a specific point in time such as every morning, repeatedly or whenever someone comes close![/p][p]Once again before implementing these, we wanted to visualize where you would apply them and also what types of seals we would have alongside an idea of what the little icons could look like:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/aa795eb2e4d6a9084b90ea2b51e541586baf60d3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In this case we even went ahead and chopped up the concept art to use it in our game for a while - it definitely made us giggle every time… 😅[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/1e9fb240fef515835eb7bc77ded060652ac460fd.png"][/img][/p][p]Until finally we of course replaced the seals with the pretty pixel version and finalized the UI for it as well:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/27e77a7c46a9935ec17dae8f8927a5055798c84d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]💇 Character Customization[/h2][p]Everyone loves character customization, right? Getting to make just a few changes to make your character look more like yourself or the way you want just adds a little something to the overall feel! And so of course we also wanted to add that to Ritual of Raven. ✨[/p][p]Once again it all sort of started with an initial sketch:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/573fc3b5bcd32493e2c79046de9ee1ce41706c73.png"][/img][/p][p]The first version we then built into the game was admittedly not the cutest, but simply meant to be very practical:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/a8faa2b1e406d248061c55f79270280b6db72df2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And after we had implemented a few more hairstyles and clothing options, we once again sat down to create some mock-ups and ended up with our final version:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/6350b6aea355ccf11d7a5b115701b430225ae472.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]🛋️ Interiors[/h2][p]Similarly, before fully implementing interiors with all their items and functions in the game, we first worked on some concepts: Putting together the basic layout, must have-items that fit their story and personality as well as a color scheme:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/6638f36fdb6cd6b942525ad1434f4501c83a7f72.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]🤩 Before & After[/h1][p]And last but not least, why not go over a couple of fun before & after pictures! 🥳[/p][p]The main menu of the game:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/2fcedafb123cdfff1cf16f1b028182e0a74b4b08.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The sleep screen, when going to the next day:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/1086f07d77e37da7809cc2ba99d95261a025d216.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And the map with placeholder houses and puzzle locations vs. the final map overview:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/2bf1321fae90aefdfef7f8da6225851c2342344d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]__[/p][p]And there we have it. A nice little trip down memory lane in preparation for the full release! 🥰[/p][p]We hope you’re all excited and ready for August! For us it’s definitely getting more real by the minute and anticipation (as well as nervousness) is for sure rising![/p][p]We can’t wait for you to experience Ritual of Raven VERY soon![/p][p]-Spellgarden Games 🔮[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Let’s talk about Decorating & our RELEASE DATE?! 😮
notes.notes:
Hi there! Now if you read that title, you know that we’ve actually got some news today that we’re really excited to share with you (and also a little nervous because this makes it all the more real…) But before we reveal the great date, we also wanted to take today to look at all the decorating you’ll be able to do in Ritual of Raven! 🛋️

[h1]✨ Decorating in Ritual of Raven[/h1]

We’ve talked about the constructs and the tarot cards, the villagers and friendships, the farming & spells and ok yes, we’ve also [i]briefly[/i] [url=store.steampowered.com/news/app/2066520/view/603016424736161833?l=english] mentioned the decorating [/url], but let’s dive a little deeper into that today! 💫

[h2]🗺️ Where can you decorate?
[/h2]
We absolutely loved seeing the creativity of players, so we wanted to make sure to give you quite a bit of freedom when it comes to making the world of Ritual of Raven feel like your own! 

So you can actually decorate pretty much [i]everywhere[/i]. Of course that includes the space around your house - your own farm essentially - that you can design in whichever way you want: witchy, natural, rustic…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/e0a4966532ad236d74d42bd80e8b5fc65040e307.gif[/img]

But you can also extend these decorations (or the farming itself) to the town! Give other villagers cute front yards and items you think they’ll love, lay some pathing, place some more trees and more! 🌳

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/15b003afeabdbaa8f62769ef9df49623f10fda84.gif[/img]

And of course that includes other areas as well (yes, even on the bridges!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/ecfb585c9d94377444aa86da87c4aa0991b3950a.jpg[/img]

And that’s still not all! 🤯 Because you can of course also make the interior of your own home your personal space! Once you’ve acquired enough shards, you can even buy expansions and transform a once quaint little cottage into a remarkable home!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/1cbd372dca5cda9ae9361035059965ec48a29b27.png[/img]

[h2]🎮 How does it work?
[/h2]
But how exactly does the decorating work in Ritual of Raven? Well, that poses two separate questions: [i]Where do you get furniture?[/i] and [i]How does the actual decorating work?[/i] Both of which have quite simple answers!

You get all your furniture from Pistachio who will introduce their shop to you in the early game. They have an always changing selection of goods, so make sure to check in often and find new treasures. And if you’ve purchased something before, you can always buy more through the catalogue.

Also: Make sure to nurture the friendships with all the NPCs - sometimes you’ll get some extra special items as a reward and Pistachio even extends their shop inventory once they’ve gotten to know you a little bit better! 🥰

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/20c0820bc6628eda8d9ea77ec758aab893ffd3c9.gif[/img]

And all you have to do to actually place the newly required items in the world around you is enter Placement Mode through your wheel menu (Q on keyboard, LB on controller) and that’s it! Now you can decorate however you like! And you can also move around the camera a bit to decorate outside the frame. 🖼️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/a378299c3dde72d8bf2ddadf734b17a3298bb52f.gif[/img]

[h2]✨ Enchanting Decorations
[/h2]
And we definitely wanted to bring that automation vibe to the decorations as well, so a variety of the items can also be enchanted! Which means they can change their color or also light up!

And you can also combine these with some other cards and seals making for a really customizable and fun experience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/da9df8f2eb54a825111a56f8a7d44b082d66607a.gif[/img]

[h2]🪑 Item Selection
[/h2]
We don’t want to share [i]everything[/i] everything just yet, because the joy of finding yet another cute item you can use on your farm is unmatched. But from the little pictures and GIFs we’ve shared in this post, as well as the little selection below, you can hopefully get a good idea and already find a few gems that will make it to your in-game wishlist!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/ce19dbeb602413c916fe1233f2bb17aaeb73cf6b.gif[/img]

[h1]📅 Ritual of Raven Release Date
[/h1]
And now finally! Our release date! You might have already seen it in our announcement yesterday or across social media:

[b][h3]🥳 Ritual of Raven is set to release August 7, 2025! 🥳
[/h3][/b]

That’s actually not too long now! Just two more months and you’ll be able to experience the decorating firsthand and further explore why all the portals are going haywire!

We hope you’re as excited as we are and in the meantime, make sure to check out the free demo in case you haven’t yet!


Until next time!
- Spellgarden Games 🔮

notes.title: A look beyond our demo: Museums & Friendship 🥰
notes.notes:
Hi there! Have you already had the chance to try out our demo? Then you might have fished up one or two [i]peculiar[/i] looking items from a portal and asked yourself what to do with them… Or maybe you talked to some of the NPCs and would have loved to know just a [i]little[/i] more about their backstory…

Well, after releasing and updating our demo, let’s take a glance beyond that and see what more will be waiting for you soon!

🤫[i]Psst, there’s also a way for you to see these features in action already, we’ll get to that at the end![/i]

[h1]📚 Complete the Museum (& more)[/h1]

Now, you may have found yourself in possession of some fun trinkets like some rose petals, a bow, a feather, or… a [i]toilet seat[/i]? 👀 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/747dba2d1c4356f2f5cae5d6abe882939a5d8594.gif[/img]

There’s truly many things you may find in portals… But then what do you do with them after? 🤔

Well, you donate them to a museum of course! Because who wouldn’t want to walk around an exhibition showcasing a toilet seat on a pedestal? To us that sounds absolutely fantastic! 🤩

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/d8bcc2ba72252b49b88dd9b81843b72016e8e48b.gif[/img]

And that’s not all! There’s also two other buildings where you can donate and collect things you can find and extract (👀) in the world around you! Happy collecting! 😍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/df83a2c144f4bcc6044aa054028c8fb633839a94.gif[/img]

And how do you unlock all of these museums and collections you ask? Well, let’s talk about: Friendships.

[h1]🌹 Building Friendships[/h1]

Nevar and the entire world of Leynia is certainly filled with a lot of quirky and interesting characters - and you’ve only met a few of them in the demo, that much we can definitely say! 🤭

But why is Dan as grumpy as he is, what are Bowies dreams and what is our familiar Raven’s journey until he met us? All of these little stories and character traits will be revealed to you, if you build up your friendship with the NPCs by gifting them some of their requested items! 🌹

Find them through exploring, talking to other NPCs and following the quests and uncover everyone’s secrets and passions one story at a time! 📖

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/e8615e9b0cc5100d20230a3e9d5a079b0539b087.gif[/img]

[previewyoutube=gLTX_ij-8Vs;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]And now: Where can you already catch a glimpse of all these new mechanics & features before the full game comes out? Well, some of your favorite content creators might just be able to play a little further than the public demo and share all this on their channels! We hope you enjoy! 🔮

As always we’d love to know what you think and if you end up finding any bugs yourself, you can let us know on our Discord server or on our socials! 💜

In the meantime practice those magic skills and we will talk to you soon! ✨
- Spellgarden Games 🔮

notes.title: An update for our demo 🥳
notes.notes:
Hi there! And can we just say: [b]Wow![/b] Finally getting to share a piece of this game we’ve been working on for the past few years has been absolutely incredible! First of all a big thank you to each and every one who already tried the Ritual of Raven Demo and wishlisted the game! 💜

As more and more people play it we have also been able to gather further feedback and tweak a few things as well as hunt down some more pesky bugs… 🐞 

Let’s talk about it! 😎 
[i](A full list of the patch notes can be found at the bottom of the post.)[/i]

[h1]🤖 Constructs no longer blocking each other[/h1]

Up until now constructs often ended up blocking each other when working on the same field or even when close to each other. They’d just end up standing around swinging their little arms awaiting further instructions. Now, that [i]can[/i] be cute for sure, but we do understand that it’s quite frustrating when you’re trying to set up your automated farm. 😮‍💨

Admittedly, this was a bit of a head scratcher for us until we figured out the actual problem might be the order in which they tend to the fields. Instead of always going from left to right (or top to bottom depending on how you’ve set your field), they now alternate directions to tend to the nearest tile! 🤯
See the Gif down below for the before and after:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/abfd8c28d1f6981419ee5de09b97ed7ad721a10a.gif[/img]

So whenever they’re in each others way now, they’ll patiently wait but then be sure to continue on their path as soon as the construct in front of them is done with their task! 🥳

⚠️ For this to work in an existing save game, please pick up your field signs once and place them down again!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/b1c36bec20e57f5e0b46b0b6f2c2fa70cea72836.gif[/img]

[h1]💾 Fixed Save Game Bug (hopefully)[/h1]

This one isn’t as visually exciting, but definitely needed! Some of you reported that your game file was lost even though you saved your progress. That’s definitely not what’s supposed to happen! 😢

So we spent the past few weeks since the demo launch trying to hunt this one down… 🐞 And we ✨think✨ we got it! So hopefully no more lost save files! 🤞

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/8d19295e72d3a1b7b19194c2b7339372a6d353a4.gif[/img]

If you end up finding bugs as you play and test the demo, please feel free to let us know either on our Discord server or on our socials! 🤝

And with that all that’s left for us to say is: Enjoy the demo & keep practicing your magic skills! 🧙


We’re very excited to hear from you!
- Spellgarden Games 🔮

___

[h1]🛠️ Patch Notes[/h1]
[h3]Gameplay & Balancing[/h3]
[*]Various balancing improvements
[*]Increased the number of fields and chests that can be placed
[*]Arrow keys can now be used for movement on PC

[h3]UI & UX Improvements[/h3]
[*]Improved selection for the sign icons in the magic menu
[*]Constructs now provide clearer error messages

[h3]Performance & Optimization[/h3]
[*]Improved performance
[*]Optimized performance of the preview in the enchantment menu
[*]Improved construct navigation so they don’t block each other

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[*]Fixed a bug that would lead to lost save games for some players
[*]Fixed a bug where the Book of Shadows became unresponsive with controller
[*]Removed unpickable gras and collectables near Raven
[*]Fixed a bug where items could be lost from the decoration menu
[*]Fixed some decorations not working properly
[*]Fixed crashes and deadlocks
[*]Fixed localization issues
[*]Fixed collisions issues
[*]Fixed Steam Deck-specific issues
[*]Removed debug save feature from pause menu

notes.title: Everything we changed based on your feedback 🛠️
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We can’t quite believe it, but we’re already way into 2025 which also means we’re slowly but surely making our way towards our planned release date! 🤫

Initially we wanted to talk about some general game features today, but as we did a little playtest in December, we got TONS of awesome feedback and spent the last few weeks tweaking and overhauling some mechanics. So of course we want to share those changes with you! 😍

[h1]🗺️ Easier & faster to travel across the map[/h1]

One of the things a few players mentioned was that it can take quite a long time to get from one point to another on the map. Especially when your pockets are full ([i]dang forageables, right? [/i]😅), but you need this one specific item for a quest, so you gotta go home and get it before returning to your previous location and before you know it two in-game hours have passed… 😶

That can be frustrating, we hear ya! So - we decided to approach this with two different changes! ✨

[h2]🏃 Running[/h2]

The player character can now run! Either hold down [i]Shift[/i] (on keyboard) or [i]LT[/i] (on gamepad) or enable toggle running in the settings and you will zoom across the map much faster!

Check out the difference that makes! 😮

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/796de281018c3e5ece78b8c2a63e1b41da4c2254.gif[/img]

[h2]📍 Teleports[/h2]

We didn’t stop at the running though, no no! We also decided to implement fast travel as per teleport points! 💨

These teleport points aka pillars can be found all across the map and will be unlockable using [i]Shards[/i] (our in-game currency), so you can easily hop back and forth between different key locations! 💎

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/4f830887e8e66df8931fae05c65e314320143d34.gif[/img]

[h1]🔮 Constructs & Magic Overhaul[/h1]

There’s lots of different things to do and see in the world of Ritual of Raven - but one of the key mechanics we’d love for you to use is of course the farming! Enchanting and optimizing the little constructs to automate your magical garden is truly at the heart of the game! So we were super interested to hear your feedback here! 🌼

[h2]✨ Magic Preview[/h2]

Some of you reported that it felt as though you had to babysit the constructs because you weren’t quite certain the laid out cards were correct. And listen, if you [b]want to[/b] look at the constructs carrying out the enchantments, then you shall do so (we often find ourselves quite mesmerized by the look of a busy farm). 🥰 

But of course the idea here is that they take care of your garden [i]for you[/i], so you can go explore the magical world around you! 🌱

So we decided to implement a [b]magic preview feature[/b]! Now, once you’ve laid out all the command cards, you can let the constructs show you where their path would lead, if there’s anything obstructing them and what actions they’d carry out before actually committing to it! 👏

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/476c45e5383924db5f08c251bf4f42d31609a536.gif[/img]

[h2]🤖 Faster Constructs[/h2]

And in addition to the preview feature, we’ve also decided to make the constructs much faster for most of their tasks! 

So in case you [i]do[/i] want to stand there and gaze at them (we get it, truly!), it’s now even more fun to do so! And of course that way the constructs are also able to tend to more of your garden and you can take your farming game to the next level! 💦

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/23feb54183aac7205c76458e2d636cca3c1303ed.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/d1a20a764b5869b7f008bd532ffb5f005ea4e22c.gif[/img]

[h1]🥳 See for yourself![/h1]

All that is fine and good to hear about, but you know what’s even better? You can see & try for yourself! Because we have a demo coming [b]March 3rd[/b]! 🤩

Make sure you’ve got [b]Ritual of Raven on your wishlist[/b] and keep an eye on our Steam page in the next couple of days!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/df8ab96128d67e507642dbb07f93d236523fc50b.png[/img]


We’re very excited to hear from you!
- Spellgarden Games 🔮

notes.title: Villager introductions, Customization & Decorations 🌿
notes.notes:
Hey there! The holidays are just around the corner and so is the new year, but we didn’t want to leave 2024 behind without another update about Ritual of Raven - lots has happened once again after all! ✨

[h1]👋 More quirky Friends[/h1]
In [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2066520/view/6879905860251811864?l=english]our last Dev Log[/url] we got started introducing you to some of the quirky characters waiting for you in Leynia and as promised, there’s more friends to meet! 🥰

Once again we’ll show you their different moods that can show up in conversations and tell you a few snippets about who they are! Let’s go!

[h2] Coco (she/her)[/h2]
Coco is who you want to talk to if you require any seeds for your farm - safe to say Raven absolutely [i]loves[/i] her. 😋

She is friendly but can be a little shy at first and generally tends to be on the introverted side - her lovely and down-to-earth character makes her the perfect counterpart to Charly! 🌈

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/75b1dc42a533076befba28121b09469ae75f9449.png[/img]

[h2] Charly (she/her) [/h2]
Charly can be the exact opposite of Coco in some ways: excited, outgoing & loud. But maybe that’s exactly why they work so well together. 💜

She tends to talk without really thinking things through first which can lead to some… interesting moments. But she never actually means any harm!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/99dab0def2211ee051ac3d1b28c4af73dcd50bbc.png[/img]

[h2] Dan (he/him) [/h2]
When you first meet Dan at his restaurant, he can seem quite cranky and reserved. He does actually care very deeply about people though, so it might just be worth it to befriend him! Especially for his famous [i]moist seed cake[/i]! 🍪

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/cd08c6649cc9f935b306d2dc348355f8db3b8a57.png[/img]

[h2] Huxley (he/him) [/h2]
The best dressed sloth you will probably ever meet! Huxley is a rather sleepy & slow fellow (he is a sloth after all 🦥), but that doesn’t stop his curious mind! Quite an intellectual being, you will probably find him somewhere close to some books! 📚

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/f7d3a13db92b8319625cbcfdc09c48c6465f7aa8.png[/img]

Our game isn’t fully voiced as that would have unfortunately blown up our budget 😭 - BUT each of the characters have little vocal sounds to express their emotions alongside their pictures (think [i]“Ah!”[/i], [i]“Hmm…”[/i], [i]“Uh-hu.”[/i]). We’ve been able to start implementing those these past few weeks and it’s just amazing to see their personalities come to life! Makes us smile every time! 😍

[h1]🎨 Character Customization [/h1]
This is something many of you might be excited about: We’re working on character customization! ✨

It’s still very much a WIP feature at the minute - there’s currently only 3 different hairstyles, a witchy hat, some glasses and just 2 options for tops & bottoms - but we’re still looking to add some more options in the future! Oh and you can already customize the colors! 👕

Seeing the random little chars whenever we start a new save game is already really fun though! 🎨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/0cdfb55fafb0db7eda87e94599c7bee396e8d8cc.gif[/img]

[h1]🌱 Overgrown Farm [/h1]
Another “small” change we’ve made to the world is letting it be completely overgrown with grass upon your arrival! 🌿 

You can either pluck these weeds yourself or enchant some constructs to take care of the cleaning for you! You can even get various little rewards for cleaning! 💎

Or you know, you may also leave them up for that overgrown vibe! 😍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/c452cf6de77bbb5a1d26f20e4c44f022d224f55d.png[/img]

[h1]🪑 Decorations[/h1]
With the ability to decorate your farm AND all the other areas (yes, even the town center), we of course have been working on introducing more items for you to use! And while our artist Sophie has already added tons of stuff, she still has some more pixel magic up her sleeves! 🤩

Let’s give you a sneak peek with this time lapse of a witchy bureau! 🌙

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/a70af674e5e37a69dac991c6329db6d8a198d344.gif[/img]

We now have a decent assortment of different tables, chairs, wardrobes & many other furniture pieces! We cannot wait to see how you will decorate your farms! ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/2cdf9a64d17998ee69313b2560ce92b9b2309e67.gif[/img]

And thus concludes our little update just before the end of 2024 is approaching! We’d like to thank you all for your support this year and all your wishlists so far, we cannot wait to share more updates with you in the future! Here’s a tiny teaser to hold you over in the meantime: 📚 & 🎣! 😉

[b]Happy holidays & a happy New Year![/b] We’ll see you very soon! 
- Spellgarden Games 🔮

[h2]Sage (she/her)[/h2]
As the first person you stumble into upon your arrival, Sage will help you find your way around the farm and introduce you to magic! Let the witch lessons begin! ✨
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/63f811e80364c3abc67d444f7df28bf74c8dd8db.png[/img]
[h2]Raven (he/him)[/h2]
Raven will join your side as your animal companion - your familiar - and therefore support and be with you through everything! It’s surely good to have a friend - especially one with a side of cheeky remarks! 😌 
[i](Just make sure you always have enough seeds and sparkly things for him.)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/8bdc8517e1849b9e01a11decccc5585e353601c2.png[/img]
[h2]Bowie (he/they)[/h2]
As the somewhat self-appointed local Orientation Wagon, Bowie is sure to welcome you to the village with his guitar always by his side.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/2ba0d90ef78173e043f70b699793cdffd9331a9d.png[/img]
[h2]Pistachio (they/them)[/h2]
Pistachio is who you need to go see when it comes to furniture and decorations! They are very proud of their portal fishing skills - but is that really the whole story?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/7341555285bd216f195e7e822c5502ee8118c359.png[/img]
We’re excited to introduce you to some more villagers soon!

[h1]🪴 Arcana Constructs[/h1]
We can’t possibly write our first dev log without mentioning our [b]Arcana Constructs[/b]! They’re a mix of robot and magical being and can be found all over the world! Once unlocked you can enchant them to take care of your magical herb garden! 🌱

As they also hint at some more areas coming soon, we can’t reveal them all just yet, but here’s some constructs doing their cute little walk animation for you:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/bfc2df3542e3492c84b3ff4f3b4a7df53c11ce6f.gif[/img]
[h1]📜 Story Progress[/h1]
We’re very happy to report that we’ve been working hard on implementing all the quests and storyline in general and our game now actually has an ending!! 🥳

We don’t want to share and spoil too much here, but save to say it feels really awesome and a little surreal! Now it’s really down to making this a well-rounded game and filling it with more details & personality!

[h1]✨ Spell jars & Blocked Areas[/h1]
Speaking of: We needed to do just that with the beginning of our game as well, to give you a true sense of progress and always some new small things to do as you go on your journey.

So we’ve now added a new feature: ✨spell jars✨

Spell jars are essentially small rituals you can perform to clean up the world and make it more home-y or also unlock areas filled with new forageables! You can find and collect fragments of spell jar recipes all over the world! That way you’ll be sure to be a busy witch. 🪄

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/58bfece05fdefc0e48d06d16da0ebe8dacb4bc30.jpg[/img]
[h1]👀 Somewhere between bugs & coming soon[/h1]
Even with all these implementations and improvements, it’s save to say we still have a decent chunk left to do between a variety of bugs as well as lots of unfinished areas…
[table noborder=1]
    [tr]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/0a7f23c30208af25383eb5334fa0fe3062d3712d.gif[/img][/th]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/0ede9fcf368563bd22fcceea6826fa72b579ca06.gif[/img][/th]
    [/tr]
[/table]
And here’s a little peek into what is coming up next: [b]Character Customization! [/b]🎨 

We’ve already started implementing the bare bones so the colors can be changed, but we’re far from done! More coming soon! 🤫

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149253/157bb51079c028fe37487beb51d86326ec84ca99.png[/img]

Until next time! 
- Spellgarden Games 🔮
